title: Wiemer header
description: A slim 72px fixed bar: a plain wordmark on the left, one circled-arrow call to action on the right. Over a hero it starts transparent with light text (a brand-orange bar on phones) and turns into a near-white bar with a hairline once the hero has passed. It slides up out of the way while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up.
notes: overlay floats it over the next block (the hero); without overlay it is solid and leaves a 72px spacer so the page starts below it
the light text over the hero assumes a dark photo or placeholder behind it
